name: Floaters
desc: Eye floaters over the whole frame — out-of-focus collagen debris in chained strands, squiggles and Weiss rings, each a soft haze inside a bright refractive rim, sinking under gravity and lagging the gaze: every few seconds the eye flicks, the vitreous keeps going, overshoots and settles with a damped wobble. Clinical, entoptic and quietly unnerving.

energy.doc: debris size, rim contrast and how far the gaze lurches

density.doc: number of floaters and beads per strand

alpha.doc: overlay opacity — high by default because floaters are inherently faint

hue.doc: debris hue (190 cold vitreous, 40 warm sclera, 300 phosphene violet)

style.doc: aesthetic: soft defocused haze inside refractive rims, as they really look / hard-edged high-contrast marks, no blur, pure graphic silhouette / darkfield slide with a graticule and measurement ticks, clinical / entoptic light instead of shadow, additive blooms in odd colours

act.doc: dramaturgy: slow sink with the odd eye flick / restless eyes, the field lurching often / no saccades at all, just the sink and wobble — meditative
